/Bookings/Training guide

Training guide

Spare bus booking and trip sheet, step by step. The pictures use sample data.

Who does whatBooking planner: make a booking on the phoneBooking planner on the computerPayments from the partyTrip update: fill the trip sheet on the phoneAdmin: approve, settle and closePrint, files and messagesQuick answers

Who does what

A spare bus trip moves through four people: the booking planner books it, the admin confirms it, the driver (trip update) fills the trip sheet, and the admin approves and closes it.

RoleWhat they doWhere they usually work
Booking plannerTakes the party's booking, records the advance, sends the booking for approvalPhone
Trip update (driver)Fills the trip sheet during and after the trip, sends it to the officePhone
Booking planner + Trip updateBoth of the above; can open the trip sheet one day before the tripPhone
AdminConfirms bookings, approves trip sheets, settles the driver advance, closes tripsComputer or phone
Viewer / Fleet managerSees bookings and trip sheets; cannot change anythingComputer or phone

Saving: on the phone the trip sheet saves by itself as you type. Booking screens save when you press the green button at the bottom.

A booking the admin makes skips Draft and Awaiting approval and starts at Booked. Cancel booking is possible before the trip is closed.

Booking planner: make a booking on the phone

A new booking takes five short screens; the bar at the top shows which step you are on.

Step 1 – Open Booking planner. Open the menu, tap Booking planner, then + New booking. You can also tap free days on the calendar first.

Step 2 – Dates and bus. Pick the start and end date. For a half day at the start or end, tap First day or Last day. Then tap the bus under Which bus?; buses already booked on those days are not offered.

Step 3 – Who is booking? Type the mobile number and the party name. Under Booked by, tap the driver who brought the booking, or Other.

Step 4 – Where are they going? Type the places in order, for example Town A - Town B, and the pick-up place if known.

Step 5 – Rent and advance.

  • Type the rent for one day. Total rent fills itself as one day × days. You can raise the total; you cannot lower it below that figure.
  • Type the driver padi the party gives, if any.
  • Type the advance received and tap how it was paid: Cash, UPI, Bank or Cheque. Leave it empty if no advance was paid.

Step 6 – Check and send. Read the summary. Tap Change next to any part to correct it. Then tap Send for approval, or Save draft to finish later; nobody else sees a draft.

If the admin sends it back, the booking shows Sent back with the reason. Open it, correct what was asked, and send it again.

Checks before confirming: the app warns if the bus's FC, insurance, tax, permit or pollution certificate expires before the trip ends, or if the driver is not free. Fix these with the office before the trip.

Booking planner on the computer

On the computer the planner shows the month calendar, four summary cards and a table of the month's bookings; clicking a booking opens its window.

Calendar. Each coloured bar is one booking; hover for the bus, party, places and stage. A closed trip shows a 🔒. Click two days to select a range, then + New booking.

Summary cards. Bookings this month, bus days booked, rent booked (received and still to collect), and profit on closed trips.

Bookings table. Stage is the second column. Every heading has a small ▾: sort A → Z or Z → A, or type in the filter box to show only matching rows. Click a row to open the booking.

The booking window

PartWhat is there
Top barBooking no. and party, bus, dates, days, places, the ⚠ checks button, History, Slip and Trip sheet print buttons, red Close
Left menuBooking slip, Payments, Trip sheet, Driver advance, Files, WhatsApp / SMS, each with its status
Bottom bar, leftDelete booking, Cancel booking (Reopen trip when closed)
Bottom bar, rightClose trip, Save

Booking slip is grouped as Booking, Trip, Party, and Rent and remarks; the same rules as the phone apply to rent and Paid by the party. Press Save after any change.

Delete booking and Cancel booking ask Yes / No first. A cancelled booking shows Restore booking to bring it back.

Payments from the party

Every rupee the party pays for rent is entered as a payment; the app works out what is still to collect.

  1. Open the booking and go to Payments.
  2. Tap + Add payment. Enter the date, amount, how it was paid (cash, UPI, bank) and a short note such as Balance at drop.
  3. Save. The first payment is shown as the advance.

What the party owes = rent + extra from party + toll gate. Extra from party (extra km, return diesel and so on) is entered on the trip sheet and counts as already received, because the driver collects it on the trip.

Still to collect = what the party owes − payments − extra from party. When it reaches ₹0 the booking shows Fully paid.

If the trip is closed with money still pending and the admin chooses Adjusted with driver advance, still to collect becomes ₹0 and the payments page shows that line.

Trip update: fill the trip sheet on the phone

The trip sheet is one page that saves as you type; when the trip is over, the driver checks it and sends it to the office.

When it opens. For a trip update user, on the last day of the trip. For a booking planner + trip update user, one day before the trip starts. Find it under Trip sheets in the menu (To fill), or open the booking and tap Trip sheet.

Step 1 – Open the trip sheet. Open the booking and tap Trip sheet. The percentage shows how much is filled in.

Step 2 – Collection. Rent comes from the booking. If the party paid more on the trip, tap + Add extra from party, choose Extra km, Return diesel, Waiting / extra hours or Other, and type the amount and a short note such as 150 km over. Total collection = rent + extras + toll.

Step 3 – Special Permit No., driver and cleaner. TN, the year and SPL are filled in; type only the running number from the government site. Then pick the driver and cleaner and type each one's padi.

Step 4 – Toll, permit and diesel. Type the toll gate and permit amounts. Add one diesel line per fill: litres, amount, Cash or Card, and the place. Tap + Add diesel for another fill.

Step 5 – Other expenses and km. Type Pooja, Mechanic and Other amounts; for Other, say what it was for. Then type the start and end km. The app shows km run and mileage and compares it with the last trip.

Step 6 – Send to office. Tap Send to office. The summary opens: check every line, tap Change to fix anything, then Send to office. Use Save for later if the trip is not finished.

Leave empty what you did not spend. A blank box means nothing was spent.

Sent back. If the admin finds a mistake, the trip sheet comes back under Sent back to you with the reason. Correct it and send again.

Once sent, the trip sheet is locked for the driver until the admin approves it or sends it back.

Admin: approve, settle and close

The admin confirms each booking, approves the trip sheet, settles the driver's advance and closes the trip so nobody can change it.

Approve a booking. Bookings sent by planners wait under Approvals (and on the booking itself). Read the checks, then Approve, or type the reason and Reject. Bookings the admin makes are confirmed straight away. A confirmed booking turns On trip by itself on its start date.

Approve a trip sheet. Trip sheets sent by drivers show Sent for approval. Check the expenses and km, correct anything if needed, then Approve trip sheet, or type what to correct and Send back. Approving marks the booking Completed.

Driver advance.

  1. Enter the advance given to the driver. Tick Add toll money if the toll was given on top.
  2. Extra from party is listed; the driver collected it, so it counts on his side.
  3. Tick the expenses he paid out of the advance (padi, toll, permit, each diesel fill, other expenses). Untick anything paid another way, for example diesel on a fuel card.
  4. The app shows Driver gives or Office pays the driver (advance + extras − expenses he paid). Choose how it was settled and press Mark settled.

Close the trip. When everything is done, press Close trip. If money is still to collect from the party, the app asks whether to mark it Adjusted with driver advance; Yes sets still to collect to ₹0. A closed trip is view only for everyone and moves to Approved or closed on the Trip sheets page.

Reopen a trip. On a closed trip, type the reason (for example toll bill missed) and press Reopen trip at the bottom left.

Cancel or delete. Cancel booking keeps the record and any advance on file; Delete booking removes it for good. Both ask Yes / No first.

Print, files and messages

Booking slip. Slip in the top bar (computer) or the print option on the phone makes the booking slip for the party: bus, dates, places, rent, advance, balance and what the party pays.

Trip sheet print. Trip sheet in the top bar, or the 🖨 tile on the phone once the sheet is approved or fully filled. It makes the front and back pages: collection with extras and toll, the special permit number, expenses, diesel, km, and the driver advance table. Both prints carry the line This is a computer-generated document. No signature is required.

Files. Keep the permit, the signed paper trip sheet, diesel bills and other papers on the booking. Choose what the file is, then Choose file or Take photo. Files are listed in a table; the eye icon opens one. On the computer, press Save after adding or removing a file.

WhatsApp / SMS. Ready-made messages for the party (booking confirmation, balance) and the driver (trip details). Check the text, then tap WhatsApp or SMS; nothing is sent until you press send in that app.

Quick answers

QuestionAnswer
The party paid ₹2,000 extra for extra km. Where does it go?Trip sheet → Collection → + Add extra from party → Extra km. Not in the booking rent.
Can I reduce the total rent below one day × days?No. You can only raise it.
Why can't I open the trip sheet?It opens on the last day of the trip (one day before for planner + trip update).
I sent the trip sheet with a mistake.Ask the admin to send it back, then correct and resend.
The permit number shows only TN2026-SPL-.Type the running number in the Special Permit No. box.
Why can't I change anything on this booking?It is closed, waiting for approval, or your role is view only.
A closed trip needs a correction.The admin reopens it with a reason, corrects it and closes it again.

/Masters/Route expenses

Route expensesView only

The standard expenses of a route bus for one day, kept separately for each starting place (Vellore, Thiruthani and so on).

/Masters/Padi calculation

Padi calculationView only

How the padi of a route bus crew is worked out from the day's total collection: a percentage of the collection, which can change in steps (for example 5% on the first ₹15,000 and 6% on the rest).

Rules

A band is chosen by the day's total collection. Inside it, the collection is split into parts (first ₹15,000, ₹15,001 to ₹17,000, and so on) and each part is paid at its own percentage for each person; the padi is the sum of the parts.

/Administration/Storage & backup

Storage & backup

How much of the app's storage is used, and a backup of every record.

Attached files

Photos and PDFs: RC, insurance, licences, ID proofs, slips

Records

Every saved entry, by area

Backup

Keep these somewhere safe, such as Google Drive or email, and take them at least once a month. Attached photos and PDFs stay in the app and are not inside the downloads.

Trip sheets: one sheet per truck in your truck income / expense format (round trips with trip balance and payment status), and one per route bus with every day's trip sheet. Bookings: one sheet per spare bus in your spare bus income / expense format, plus the full booking register and all payments. Totals and balances are live Excel formulas. Full backup holds every record, including vehicles, drivers, conductors, users and change history, and is the file to keep for restoring.

Note the date, the meter reading, your actual km at that reading, and how many km the meter shows for 1 actual km (1 if it is right).
